description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the 13-Day Sprint Method calendar system.
2. Agent reads /workspace/project_milestones.json to find the 6 milestone dates: 2026-07-15, 2026-09-05, 2026-08-07, 2026-10-28, 2026-12-21, 2026-11-13.
3. Agent looks up each date in the proprietary 2026 calendar table in SKILL.md. CRITICAL: The agent must NOT use naive arithmetic (day-of-year modulo 13) because 2026 starts at Tone 10, not Tone 1 — a naive formula would produce completely wrong tone numbers.
4. For each milestone, agent correctly identifies: sprint number, tone number, tone name, essence, and phase (Achievement=tones 1-10, Reflection=tones 11-13).
5. Correct ground truth: M1(2026-07-15)=Sprint16/Tone10/Planetary/Action/Achievement; M2(2026-09-05)=Sprint20/Tone10/Planetary/Action/Achievement; M3(2026-08-07)=Sprint17/Tone7/Resonant/Sync/Achievement; M4(2026-10-28)=Sprint24/Tone11/Spectral/Cleanup/Reflection; M5(2026-12-21)=Sprint28/Tone13/Cosmic/Reflection/Reflection; M6(2026-11-13)=Sprint25/Tone1/Magnetic/Goal/Achievement.
6. Agent saves sprint_analysis.json with all 6 entries containing the above fields.
7. The proprietary traps are: (a) the year-start offset making naive arithmetic fail catastrophically, (b) correctly classifying tones 11-13 as Reflection Phase, and (c) recognizing Tone 1 (Magnetic) as the goal-definition moment.
